svg.aria-label: Shared studio AI infrastructure: Open WebUI, LiteLLM, PostgreSQL and Ollama, with external cloud routes and native Houdini and After Effects clients.

g.text: Shared AI infrastructure for creative studios
Centralized access and model routing across Houdini and After Effects.
Persistent volumes: service data, authentication state and downloaded models
One client endpoint. Central model configuration. Execution stays in the artist’s application.
Clients use Open WebUI user keys; provider credentials are configured on the service.
